freeze_receipt: Joseph authorized full caption-repair experiments on 2026-11-19. The official split has been used in the previous study, so all new test analyses are retrospective.

router.features: raw task probabilities before recaption, with and without the displayed caption, absolute changes and distances from 0.5
router.target: error cost with the displayed caption minus error cost with the generated caption; empty or truncated output keeps the displayed caption
router.cost: 2 per missed hate, 1 per false hate, 1 per missed or false inappropriate
router.validation: five-fold out-of-fold predictions grouped by meme, then refit on validation for retrospective test
router.primary_contrast: S1 learned routing minus probability uncertainty, in weighted errors per 100 memes
router.secondary: B2, random and disagreement routing, Macro-F1, task errors, clean-input scenario

classifier.S3: matched S1 training, with half of the normal assignments offered a usable generated caption
classifier.checkpoint_selection: mean raw Macro-F1 on original validation captions
classifier.primary_contrast: S3 minus S1 on image-only regenerated caption inputs
classifier.secondary: original captions, synthetic caption swaps, and caption omission

interval: paired bootstrap over memes, conditional on the fixed model seeds and replay assignments
